name: Anime Club Weekly Meeting
description: Join Anime Club as we have our weekly meetings to discuss and watch anime from different genres! Every week there will be a different theme posted in our GroupMe and then we watch anime related to that theme during our meeting! There will also be a chance for you to receive a plush and comfortable hoodie or a snazzy t-shirt. Please contact Dominique (Domo) Martin [dominique.martin@furman.edu] or Kevin Sanders [kevin.sanders@furman.edu] if you have any questions or concerns. If you are unable to come to in person meetings, have no fear! We are a hybrid organization that has members that are on and off campus! Once you have signed into GroupMe a Zoom link will be provided.
